settings.a: Lithium carbonate, the medicine, is prescribed at hundreds of milligrams and monitored with blood tests. Lithium orotate is the same mineral in a trace amount: 5 mg of elemental lithium per capsule, in a form the body absorbs efficiently. It is a dietary supplement, not a medication, and it does not replace one.

settings.q: How much should I take, and when?
settings.a: One capsule a day with food. Most people take it with breakfast. Do not exceed the recommended dose.

settings.q: How long until I notice anything?
settings.a: Trace minerals build gradually. Many customers describe feeling more level somewhere between week two and week six. Give it a full bottle before you decide.

settings.q: Can I take it with other supplements or medication?
settings.a: It combines well with a daily multivitamin or omega-3. If you take prescription medication, especially anything for mood, or you are pregnant or nursing, talk to your healthcare provider before starting.

settings.q: What else is in the capsule?
settings.a: Nothing else active. Lithium (as orotate) 5 mg is the only ingredient. The rest is the vegetable cellulose capsule and the standard flow agents: microcrystalline cellulose, silica and magnesium stearate.
